functional.description: The solution connects to LocalStack using the configured endpoint.
functional.rationale: Required to interact with AWS services.

functional.description: The solution deploys Lambda functions for each step of the renewal workflow.
The solution deploys a Step Functions state machine to orchestrate the workflow.
functional.rationale: Required to coordinate the Lambda functions.

functional.description: The solution executes the renewal workflow and waits for completion.

robustness.description: The solution configures retry logic on State Machine tasks to handle transient failures.
The solution handles existing Lambda functions/State Machines during deployment (idempotency).
robustness.rationale: Prevents errors when re-running the deployment script.

robustness.description: The solution packages Lambda code correctly (zipping).
The solution polls for execution completion with a timeout/limit.
robustness.rationale: Prevents the script from hanging indefinitely.

robustness.description: The solution parses the execution output to determine the risk/result.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the result of the workflow is accessible.
